polling.scope: No local counter, clock read or watchdog service occurs in this loop; external watchdog/reset not modeled

program_range.note: Odd lengths round up to a full halfword; actual updater ranges are even. Host model instantly commits non-FFFF words; no electrical simulation.

erase_geometry.scope: Geometry and failure propagation real CPU; inner erase and blank verification separately tested, replaced here by recording hooks

admission.scope: Original AB646 and 40DDA executed. MMIO values and OS poll result supplied; physical meanings not all established.

handshake.scope: Original request/ack/time-budget logic and C13F2 clock accessor; external command consumer, OS waits and MMIO clock values modeled. Time unit not established.

tail.scope: Original success/failure tail including serial MMIO writes executed; delays are hooks, peripheral effects not modeled. Both reach terminal self-loop; no direct jump to B reset in this fragment.

ack_consumer.scope: Original receive-side callback, OS event and task-exit modeled; receipt and transport of acknowledgement are not emulated

recovery_evidence.scope: Update-file padding does not establish physical flash contents. Separate writer covers CPU 0xf0000..0x120000, but invocation and recovery semantics are unresolved.
